adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` fails, but it is only reset in the Cancel button handler. It is not reset when the user edits `MultiEmail` (the `setMultiEmailValue` callback doesn’t clear the flag) nor in `addGuestsMutation.onSuccess` (which closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`, but not `isInvalidEmail`). Therefore the error banner can persist during subsequent valid edits, and can reappear on the next open after a successful add.
